Host Kaleb Blyton
Meet Your Host

Kaleb Blyton

Kaleb Blyton knows the trades. Not from a distance — from the inside. He's spent years in and around home services, talking to the people who wake up before sunrise, load the truck, and make things work when everyone else is still asleep.

Behind the Door was born out of one simple observation: the best conversations happen after the cameras turn off. The technician who cracked the code on their routing. The owner who almost lost everything and rebuilt. The person who was told the trades weren't good enough — and went on to build something nobody can ignore.

This show exists for all of them. No corporate-speak. No highlight reels. Just the truth, told by the people living it.
